title: Men’s March Madness Sets Opening-Day Viewership Record

facts.fact: Thursday's March Madness Round of 64 TV coverage across CBS, TNT, TBS, and truTV averaged 9.1 million viewers, up 6% from the prior year, according to preliminary Nielsen data cited by the article.
facts.quote: TV coverage across CBS, TNT, TBS, and truTV averaged 9.1 million viewers, up 6% from last year.

facts.fact: Thursday's primetime coverage averaged 12.2 million viewers, a first-round record, per the article.
facts.quote: Viewership shot up further during primetime, averaging 12.2 million viewers to set a first-round record.

facts.fact: Alabama State–Saint Francis drew 1.4 million viewers in the First Four.
